summary: Clarifies and updates a single sentence in RFC 3979 about third-party intellectual property disclosures. When someone else files a disclosure, the IETF Executive Director is to notify the IPR holder and ask whether they have any disclosure to make. It is a best current practice, later replaced by RFC 8179.

eli5.summary: If someone else says your invention is part of a project, the project's manager tells you and asks if you have anything to add. This note makes that rule clear.

questions: what is a third party ipr disclosure
how does the ietf handle third party ipr disclosures
